description: Dry run of a Google Shopping campaign, step 1 of 2: the very request create_google_shopping_campaign would send, validated by Google with validateOnly — nothing is created in the ad account. Returns { currency, payload } or Google's own refusal (a duplicate name above all). It does record that a dry run happened, which is the evidence the owner needs before arming campaign creation on the Ads page; it arms nothing and needs no owner switch. Needs a signed-in connection with the ads:write scope and a role that works with ads; an API token is refused because it carries no role. Show the person the payload before creating. Idempotent. Use list_ad_accounts for the account and currency, and create_google_shopping_campaign for step 2.

dailyBudget.description: Daily budget as a positive decimal string in the ad account's currency, for example '15.00'. Send only an amount the person stated. Refused if it is above the owner's cap.

labelIndex.description: Optional: which custom label slot (0 to 4) limits the campaign to a group of products. Needs labelValue.

labelValue.description: Optional: the value of that custom label, for example 'margin_high'. Needs labelIndex.

maxCpc.description: Maximum cost per click as a positive decimal string in the ad account's currency, for example '0.40'.

name.description: Campaign name, at most 128 characters. Google refuses a name already in use.

name: preview_google_shopping_campaign
title: Preview Google Shopping campaign
